about: The rules clinozy-be and clinozy-fe share, as data. A true copy in both repositories (the mirror tests keep the two identical); each repository has a conformance test that checks its own code against it: clinozy-be src/tests/unit/ci/shared-contract.policy.unit.test.ts, clinozy-fe tests/ci/shared-contract.policy.test.ts. <prefix> is be or fe; <this-repository> and <other-repository> are the two repository names, from the reader side.
sameTaskSection:
## Same task, same pattern in both repositories

<this-repository> and <other-repository> share many tasks: CI actions, pre-push test selection, session hooks, agent-os tooling, failure issues. A task both repositories have uses **the same pattern in both**: the same rule shape, comment wording, test shape and PR title. The two differ only where a repository needs a different step (its own paths, language or file layout), and the PR says what differs and why. Before finishing a change here, check whether <other-repository> has the same task; if it does, make the same change there in a sibling PR. The files kept byte-identical in both are listed in [`<mirror-test>`](<mirror-test>); everything else that shares a shape is a parallel implementation that follows this rule.
